Image generation requesting multiple images with n=3

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\CreateImageRequest;
use Liter\Llm\Image;
$result = LiterLlm::imageGenerate(new \Liter\Llm\CreateImageRequest(prompt: "A cat",
model: "dall-e-3",
n: 3));
var_dump($result->getData());
var_dump($result->getData()[0]->url);
var_dump($result->getData()[1]->url);
var_dump($result->getData()[2]->url);
```
